source_contract.variant: Same qualified FP8-only stable-descriptor port and fixture-owned validation callback in every arm; no configured-timer guard or scoped-cache prototype.
source_contract.no_historical_pooling: Prior cohorts provide source/protocol context only; no historical or admission observations enter current estimates.

qualified_source.version_limit: Official fallback package0.0.0+unknown/unknown; exact source manifests and native artifacts establish identity.

fixture_contract.selection: Prespecified first-layer MLP down projection from the same checkpoint and exact prior 144 input token IDs, before observing any tuning or execution timing. Verify actual dimensions and capture provenance.
fixture_contract.source: Dense BF16 reference forward with actual captured post-nonlinearity activation; benchmark uses static per-tensor FP8 weights/activations through the SGLang linear facade.

arms.default: Actual wrapper with tuning disabled and no v2 context; genuine fallback misses.
arms.v1: Actual legacy autotune(True) and existing save/load; v2 context replaced by nullcontext only in manual harness.
arms.v2: Unchanged SGLang wrapper: legacy persistence plus autotune_v2(mode=tune,persistent_cache=False).

protocol.contexts: No managed store, scoped-cache prototype, added confirmation or production changes.
protocol.processes: Six blocks cover all six arm-order permutations. Every arm runs in a fresh cold process followed immediately by a fresh warm process against its saved cache: 36 timing processes. Caches are isolated by arm and trial. Six disposable trial-0 admission processes are excluded from performance estimates.
protocol.capture: After actual startup, capture natural and independent default graphs in the declared order and retain both for paired replay. A natural -1 winner still gets independently captured default graphs; never impose an exact ratio of one. Capture and mode orders are separately balanced within each arm; this is not a fully crossed order-factor experiment.
protocol.measurement: Twelve paired windows per mode, six with each role first. Warm both roles for 500 ms and rewarm 20 ms before each sample. Eager uses common batch lengths calibrated to at least 20 ms and records synchronized wall time plus GPU events. Graph uses the prior qualified fixed 16-replay window queued behind 10 million sleep cycles, with the delay BEFORE the start event; GPU-event time is primary and wall time including delay is diagnostic. Prime the sleep helper before startup in every arm. Query the start event after enqueueing and retain all pending/inconclusive outcomes. Lookup/native observers are absent from timed calls.
protocol.integrity: Verify actual warm lookup tiers, save/load byte identity, native descriptor acceptance, and numerical outputs including poisoned output and changed-input graph checks. Require zero profiling during warm startup and serving. Preserve failed and incomplete data.
protocol.freeze: Freeze capture source first. Bind generated fixture/manifest hashes and final worker sources in a second source freeze BEFORE any admission tuning or timing. Capture is excluded from performance estimates.

analysis.unit: Six complete arm blocks on one fixed fixture, GPU and time window. Warm processes are primary; cold phases are descriptive. Within-process pairs are dependent repetitions.
analysis.within_process: Median paired log(natural/default). Primary eager metric is synchronized wall time per call; primary graph metric is queued GPU-event replay time per call. Report queue-completion evidence without using it to exclude samples.
analysis.primary: Report each arm warm natural/default ratio and its geometric mean across six blocks, then the block-paired difference of v2 and v1 log ratios. Normalization against each retained default reduces but does not eliminate process/capture/history differences.
analysis.secondary: Absolute natural/default per-call latencies, absolute warm v2/v1 ratios, cold phase estimates, winner identities and profile margins, default-vs-default variation, capture/mode-order strata, and startup cost.
analysis.uncertainty: 100000 exploratory whole-block paired bootstrap resamples; seed 202610270000; type-7 percentile 95% intervals. No equivalence, safety or population claims from n=6.
analysis.no_pooling: Exclude historical and admission results. This new geometry is a separate cohort.

stopping.integrity: Stop on unexpected correctness, cache, source, native or protocol failure. Preserve evidence and explicitly amend before a separately identified attempt.
stopping.performance: Do not stop, retry, discard or expand based on timing sign.
stopping.resource: One exclusive H100 node, bounded allocation; release and verify the queue.

limits: One first-layer projection under captured dense-model activations; no full-model quantization accuracy or serving-throughput claim.
One physical GPU and time window with six blocks do not establish universal superiority or rare-failure safety.
Profiling retains original synthetic dynamic activations; serving uses captured real activations plus quantization.
The FP8 stable-descriptor port and fixture-validation callback are explicit research overlays over pinned 27c62, not a stock-release qualification.
Graph capture, allocation and history remain bundled; a ratio difference is not automatically a causal effect of candidate identity.
Existing v1 persistence remains in use. Managed stores, distributed behavior, MegaMoE and production policy are outside this checkpoint.

A pending start event after enqueue supports queued execution. A completed start event is inconclusive; retain and report it without filtering. The queue delay is excluded from graph event time but included in diagnostic wall time.

native_reuse.restoration: Restore exact source archive plus the already-qualified tools and Python-only callback patch; restore entire native cache from the prior private archive. Never rebuild or change native artifact contents.
native_reuse.timestamp_amendment: Archive extraction loses subsecond cache mtimes. Restore eight object mtimes from their unchanged .ninja_deps records. Reconstruct two library filesystem mtimes from build-log timestamps; these are explicitly not claimed original library stat mtimes. Source archive mtimes remain unchanged; every source-owned dependency must precede its recorded build timestamp.
native_reuse.reason: Prior finalist preflight showed node-local caches are cleared between allocations. Restore the preserved exact source/native bytes, then verify ordinary Ninja finds no rebuild work.
native_reuse.isolation: Separate tuner cache per mode/trial/arm, shared only from that cold process to its fresh warm process. Qualified native build cache is common; no winner cache is shared across arms or trials.
native_reuse.failure: Stop before measurement if archive/source/native hashes differ, a dependency timestamp is inconsistent, or actual pinned-container Ninja requires work. No implicit rebuild or load-only fallback.

protocol_amendments.stage: Before fixture capture and all admission/timing
protocol_amendments.reason: Independent review identified that long Python-driven replay batches could hide small GPU tactic differences behind host submission gaps.
protocol_amendments.change: Use the previously qualified queued fixed-16 graph timing for graph primary; retain calibrated 20 ms wall batches for eager. Geometry, arms, six blocks, 12 balanced pairs and source/native identities unchanged.

protocol_amendments.stage: Capture setup failed before GPU execution or tuning
protocol_amendments.reason: Docker daemon could not stat the shared-filesystem model cache; launcher exited 126 before creating the container.
protocol_amendments.change: Stage an exact hash-verified copy of the seven pinned checkpoint files in node-local storage, then bind it read-only. Preserve failed setup separately as preflight01; use a fresh study directory for the successful capture.
